event.title: FlyDubai Co-Pilot Attacked Captain with Axe, Barred from Flying Over Extremism Concerns
event.canonical_title: FlyDubai Co-Pilot Attacked Captain with Axe, Barred from Flying Over Extremism Concerns
event.summary: The co-pilot of a FlyDubai flight to Israel, identified as Omani national Hamam al-Hammami, attacked the captain with an axe in what UAE officials describe as an attempted terrorist act. Al-Hammami had previously been barred from flying in Oman due to concerns over extremist views. The incident has raised alarms within the aviation industry, already struggling from recent crises.
